title: Network

options.content:
## Network · Health & traffic
回線品質とルーターの状態、端末ごとの通信を確認できます。**Network / Device / Directionは通信分析にのみ適用**します。

panels.title: ROUTER UPTIME
panels.description: ルーター全体の指標。端末・方向フィルターは適用しません。値は選択期間の末尾です。

panels.title: CPU TEMPERATURE
panels.description: ルーター全体の指標。端末・方向フィルターは適用しません。値は選択期間の末尾です。

panels.title: CONNTRACK
panels.description: ルーター全体の指標。端末・方向フィルターは適用しません。値は選択期間の末尾です。

panels.title: CPU USAGE
panels.description: ルーター全体の指標。端末・方向フィルターは適用しません。値は選択期間の末尾です。

panels.title: MEMORY USAGE
panels.description: ルーター全体の指標。端末・方向フィルターは適用しません。値は選択期間の末尾です。

panels.title: PROBE AVAILABILITY
panels.description: 選択期間における、最も成功率の低いプローブの可用性。宛先別の成功率と停止時間は下部のPing Pong詳細を開いて確認できます。

panels.title: LAN VLANs · Measured bandwidth
panels.description: 家庭用・サーバー用・materia用VLANの合計のインターフェース実測値。TX=download、RX=upload。Network / Deviceフィルターは適用しません。内部通信・ヘッダーなども含むため、下段の外部通信フロー推定値とは完全には一致しません。

panels.title: INTERNET · ICMP latency
panels.description: Chlorineから各IPv4/IPv6宛先とMAP-E BRまでのICMP RTT。プローブ失敗時は0msとして扱わず欠測にします。端末フィルターは適用しません。

options.content:
## Traffic explorer · Devices & destinations
選択ネットワーク・端末・方向の外部通信を表示します。フローはサンプリングによる推定値で、上段のインターフェース実測値とは対象が異なります。

panels.title: TRANSFER
panels.description: 選択した期間・方向・端末の集計です。

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time,'5m',0), sum(bytes)::double precision AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM traffic WHERE (${network:sqlstring} = 'all' OR network = ${network:sqlstring})) AS network_traffic WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND direction = ${direction:sqlstring} AND (${device:sqlstring} = 'all' OR device_mac::text = ${device:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: ↓ DOWNLOAD · 5 min
panels.description: 選択端末の直近5分の推定速度。期間・方向フィルターに関係なく、各方向の現在値を表示します。

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(bytes)::double precision * 8 / 300 AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM traffic WHERE (${network:sqlstring} = 'all' OR network = ${network:sqlstring})) AS network_traffic WHERE time >= now() - interval '5 minutes' AND time < now() AND direction='download' AND (${device:sqlstring} = 'all' OR device_mac::text = ${device:sqlstring})

panels.title: ↑ UPLOAD · 5 min
panels.description: 選択端末の直近5分の推定速度。期間・方向フィルターに関係なく、各方向の現在値を表示します。

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(bytes)::double precision * 8 / 300 AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM traffic WHERE (${network:sqlstring} = 'all' OR network = ${network:sqlstring})) AS network_traffic WHERE time >= now() - interval '5 minutes' AND time < now() AND direction='upload' AND (${device:sqlstring} = 'all' OR device_mac::text = ${device:sqlstring})

panels.title: DEVICES
panels.description: 選択した期間・方向・端末の集計です。

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT device_mac)::double precision AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM traffic WHERE (${network:sqlstring} = 'all' OR network = ${network:sqlstring})) AS network_traffic WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND direction = ${direction:sqlstring} AND (${device:sqlstring} = 'all' OR device_mac::text = ${device:sqlstring})

panels.title: DATA AGE
panels.description: 全端末の最新サンプルからの経過時間。低トラフィック時にも長くなるため、収集障害の断定には使いません。

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM now()-max(time))::double precision AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM traffic WHERE (${network:sqlstring} = 'all' OR network = ${network:sqlstring})) AS network_traffic

panels.title: TRAFFIC PATHS · Device → AS → service port
panels.description: 線の太さは選択期間の推定転送量。各列の上位N件以外はOtherに集約し総量を保ちます。HTTPS等は標準ポート名の補助表示で、アプリ識別ではありません。

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected AS (
  SELECT device_mac AS device, remote_as,
         CASE
  WHEN ip_proto=6 AND service_port=443 THEN 'HTTPS · TCP/443'
  WHEN ip_proto=17 AND service_port=443 THEN 'QUIC · UDP/443'
  WHEN ip_proto IN (6,17) AND service_port=53 THEN CASE WHEN ip_proto=6 THEN 'DNS · TCP/53' ELSE 'DNS · UDP/53' END
  WHEN ip_proto=6 AND service_port=853 THEN 'DoT · TCP/853'
  WHEN ip_proto=17 AND service_port=853 THEN 'DoQ · UDP/853'
  WHEN ip_proto=6 AND service_port=80 THEN 'HTTP · TCP/80'
  WHEN ip_proto=6 AND service_port=22 THEN 'SSH · TCP/22'
  WHEN ip_proto=1 THEN 'ICMP'
  WHEN ip_proto=58 THEN 'ICMPv6'
  WHEN ip_proto IN (6,17) THEN CASE WHEN ip_proto=6 THEN 'TCP/' ELSE 'UDP/' END || service_port::text
  ELSE 'IP/' || ip_proto::text END AS service, bytes
  FROM (SELECT * FROM traffic WHERE (${network:sqlstring} = 'all' OR network = ${network:sqlstring})) AS network_traffic
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND direction = ${direction:sqlstring} AND (${device:sqlstring} = 'all' OR device_mac::text = ${device:sqlstring})
), devices AS (
  SELECT device FROM selected GROUP BY device ORDER BY sum(bytes) DESC LIMIT LEAST(50, GREATEST(1, ${top:sqlstring}::int))
), ases AS (
  SELECT remote_as FROM selected GROUP BY remote_as ORDER BY sum(bytes) DESC LIMIT LEAST(50, GREATEST(1, ${top:sqlstring}::int))
), services AS (
  SELECT service FROM selected GROUP BY service ORDER BY sum(bytes) DESC LIMIT LEAST(50, GREATEST(1, ${top:sqlstring}::int))
)
SELECT CASE WHEN device IN (SELECT device FROM devices) THEN COALESCE(d.label, device::text) ELSE 'Other devices' END AS "Device",
       CASE WHEN remote_as IN (SELECT remote_as FROM ases) THEN COALESCE(a.name, 'AS' || remote_as::text) ELSE 'Other ASes' END AS "AS",
       CASE WHEN service IN (SELECT service FROM services) THEN service ELSE 'Other services' END AS "Service",
       sum(bytes)::double precision AS "Bytes"
FROM selected LEFT JOIN device_labels d ON d.mac=selected.device
LEFT JOIN as_names a ON a.asn=selected.remote_as
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 4 DESC

panels.title: REMOTE AS · Traffic over time
panels.description: 選択期間で転送量の多い上位8組織とOtherを積み上げ表示します。

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected AS (
 SELECT time, COALESCE(a.name,'AS'||remote_as::text) AS name,bytes
 FROM (SELECT * FROM traffic WHERE (${network:sqlstring} = 'all' OR network = ${network:sqlstring})) AS network_traffic LEFT JOIN as_names a ON a.asn=remote_as WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND direction = ${direction:sqlstring} AND (${device:sqlstring} = 'all' OR device_mac::text = ${device:sqlstring})
), top_ases AS (
 SELECT name FROM selected GROUP BY name ORDER BY sum(bytes) DESC LIMIT 8
)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time,'5m',0), CASE WHEN name IN (SELECT name FROM top_ases) THEN name ELSE 'Other ASes' END AS metric,
       sum(bytes)::double precision * 8 / 300 AS value
FROM selected GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CASE family(device_ip) WHEN 6 THEN 'IPv6' ELSE 'IPv4' END AS "Family", sum(bytes)::double precision AS "Bytes" FROM (SELECT * FROM traffic WHERE (${network:sqlstring} = 'all' OR network = ${network:sqlstring})) AS network_traffic WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND direction = ${direction:sqlstring} AND (${device:sqlstring} = 'all' OR device_mac::text = ${device:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1

panels.title: DEVICES · Transfer volume & drilldown
panels.description: 端末名のリンクでダッシュボード全体を絞り込み。Download/Uploadは方向フィルターに関係なく両方向の期間合計です。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(d.label,t.device_mac::text) AS "Device", t.device_mac::text AS "MAC",
 sum(bytes) FILTER (WHERE direction='download')::double precision AS "Download",
 sum(bytes) FILTER (WHERE direction='upload')::double precision AS "Upload",
 sum(bytes)::double precision AS "Bytes", count(DISTINCT remote_as)::int AS "AS count", max(time) AS "Last seen"
FROM (SELECT * FROM traffic WHERE (${network:sqlstring} = 'all' OR network = ${network:sqlstring})) AS t LEFT JOIN device_labels d ON d.mac=t.device_mac
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (${device:sqlstring} = 'all' OR device_mac::text = ${device:sqlstring})
GROUP BY t.device_mac,d.label ORDER BY "Bytes" DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: SERVICE PORTS · Traffic mix
panels.description: 転送量の多い上位6ポートとOther。名称はポート番号からの推定であり、通信内容の解析結果ではありません。

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected AS (
 SELECT CASE
  WHEN ip_proto=6 AND service_port=443 THEN 'HTTPS · TCP/443'
  WHEN ip_proto=17 AND service_port=443 THEN 'QUIC · UDP/443'
  WHEN ip_proto IN (6,17) AND service_port=53 THEN CASE WHEN ip_proto=6 THEN 'DNS · TCP/53' ELSE 'DNS · UDP/53' END
  WHEN ip_proto=6 AND service_port=853 THEN 'DoT · TCP/853'
  WHEN ip_proto=17 AND service_port=853 THEN 'DoQ · UDP/853'
  WHEN ip_proto=6 AND service_port=80 THEN 'HTTP · TCP/80'
  WHEN ip_proto=6 AND service_port=22 THEN 'SSH · TCP/22'
  WHEN ip_proto=1 THEN 'ICMP'
  WHEN ip_proto=58 THEN 'ICMPv6'
  WHEN ip_proto IN (6,17) THEN CASE WHEN ip_proto=6 THEN 'TCP/' ELSE 'UDP/' END || service_port::text
  ELSE 'IP/' || ip_proto::text END AS service, bytes FROM (SELECT * FROM traffic WHERE (${network:sqlstring} = 'all' OR network = ${network:sqlstring})) AS network_traffic WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND direction = ${direction:sqlstring} AND (${device:sqlstring} = 'all' OR device_mac::text = ${device:sqlstring})
), ranked AS (
 SELECT service,sum(bytes)::double precision AS bytes,row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sum(bytes) DESC) AS rank
 FROM selected GROUP BY service
)
SELECT CASE WHEN rank<=6 THEN service ELSE 'Other ports' END AS "Port", sum(bytes)::double precision AS "Bytes"
FROM ranked GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: ADDRESS DETAILS · Device / remote IPs & reverse DNS

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(d.label, t.device_mac::text) AS "Device", host(t.device_ip) AS "Address",
       n.name AS "Reverse DNS", sum(t.bytes)::double precision AS "Bytes"
FROM (SELECT * FROM traffic WHERE (${network:sqlstring} = 'all' OR network = ${network:sqlstring})) AS t LEFT JOIN device_labels d ON d.mac=t.device_mac
LEFT JOIN address_names n ON n.ip=t.device_ip AND n.expires_at > now()
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.time) AND t.direction = ${direction:sqlstring}
AND (${device:sqlstring} = 'all' OR t.device_mac::text = ${device:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT host(t.remote_ip) AS "Address", n.name AS "Reverse DNS",
       COALESCE(a.name, 'AS' || t.remote_as::text) AS "AS", sum(t.bytes)::double precision AS "Bytes"
FROM (SELECT * FROM traffic WHERE (${network:sqlstring} = 'all' OR network = ${network:sqlstring})) AS t LEFT JOIN address_names n ON n.ip=t.remote_ip AND n.expires_at > now()
LEFT JOIN as_names a ON a.asn=t.remote_as
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.time) AND t.direction = ${direction:sqlstring}
AND (${device:sqlstring} = 'all' OR t.device_mac::text = ${device:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: PROBE AVAILABILITY
panels.description: Probe Availability。選択期間の実測値。イベント指標はイベント発生前に系列が存在しない場合があります。

panels.title: TCP CONNECT · FLET’S IPv6
panels.description: FLET'S IPv6 TCP Connect (ms)。選択期間の実測値。イベント指標はイベント発生前に系列が存在しない場合があります。

panels.title: NETWORK INTERFACES · WAN / other LANs / packets
WAN INTERFACES · RX / TX
panels.description: RXはルーターへの受信、TXは送信。TXを下側に反転表示します。インターフェース間の転送を含むため、各系列を足してインターネット通信量とはみなしません。

panels.title: OTHER NETWORKS · Server / materia / Tailscale
panels.description: RXはルーターへの受信、TXは送信。TXを下側に反転表示します。インターフェース間の転送を含むため、各系列を足してインターネット通信量とはみなしません。

panels.title: INTERFACE PACKETS · RX / TX
panels.description: RXはルーターへの受信、TXは送信。TXを下側に反転表示します。インターフェース間の転送を含むため、各系列を足してインターネット通信量とはみなしません。

panels.title: LINK STATE
panels.description: Link Carrier (1 = up)。選択期間の実測値。イベント指標はイベント発生前に系列が存在しない場合があります。

panels.title: INTERFACE ERRORS & DROPS
panels.description: 受信エラー・受信破棄・送信破棄をインターフェース別に表示します。

panels.title: FIREWALL DROPS
panels.description: Firewall Drops (/s)。選択期間の実測値。イベント指標はイベント発生前に系列が存在しない場合があります。

panels.title: INVALID PACKETS
panels.description: Invalid Packets (/s)。選択期間の実測値。イベント指標はイベント発生前に系列が存在しない場合があります。

panels.title: KERNEL & CONNTRACK ERRORS
panels.description: 異なるエラーを足し合わせず、種類別の系列として表示します。

panels.title: TCP CONNECTIONS
panels.description: TCP Established。選択期間の実測値。イベント指標はイベント発生前に系列が存在しない場合があります。

panels.title: TCP RETRANSMISSIONS
panels.description: TCP Retransmits (/s)。選択期間の実測値。イベント指標はイベント発生前に系列が存在しない場合があります。

panels.title: HARDWARE & SYSTEM · Temperatures / CPU frequency / storage
HARDWARE TEMPERATURE · NVMe / board
panels.description: NVMe / Board Temperature (°C)。選択期間の実測値。イベント指標はイベント発生前に系列が存在しない場合があります。

panels.title: CPU FREQUENCY
panels.description: CPU Frequency (GHz)。選択期間の実測値。イベント指標はイベント発生前に系列が存在しない場合があります。

panels.title: CONTEXT SWITCHES
panels.description: Context Switches (/s)。選択期間の実測値。イベント指標はイベント発生前に系列が存在しない場合があります。

panels.title: LOAD AVERAGE · 5 min
panels.description: Mackerelのホスト／コンテナ指標をPrometheusの指標で代替。CPUは100%=1コア（ルーター・ノードは全コア平均）。メモリはworking setまたはMemTotal−MemAvailable。

panels.title: FILESYSTEM USAGE
panels.description: Mackerelのホスト／コンテナ指標をPrometheusの指標で代替。CPUは100%=1コア（ルーター・ノードは全コア平均）。メモリはworking setまたはMemTotal−MemAvailable。

panels.title: DISK WRITES
panels.description: Disk Write (bytes/s)。選択期間の実測値。イベント指標はイベント発生前に系列が存在しない場合があります。

panels.title: Logs — Selected Time Range
panels.description: 同じ選択期間のログ。最大100行。

list.name: device
list.label: Device
list.query: SELECT 'All devices' AS __text,'all' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(d.label,t.device_mac::text) AS __text,t.device_mac::text AS __value FROM (SELECT * FROM traffic WHERE (${network:sqlstring} = 'all' OR network = ${network:sqlstring})) AS t LEFT JOIN device_labels d ON d.mac=t.device_mac WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY t.device_mac,d.label ORDER BY 1

description: Unified Chlorine Router, Ping Pong and all-LAN flow dashboard. Shared time range/crosshair; network, device and direction filters apply only to flow panels. Interface counters are measured, flow counters are sampled estimates.
